full_page.content:
1953, Sept. 24
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
St. Felix Friary Route 8 Huntington, Indiana
Sept. 24th 1953
Blessed be God In all His designs.
God bless you Mr. Frank M. Foran -- you and yours. Many thanks for your appreciated favor of a week ago, which only just now I got to read -- as it was striking 10 P.M. Glory be to God!
9/25/53. To-day My associate in the Seraphic Mission work tells me he wrote
(unfinished)
